description: This file defines the 'TranslationCollection' class within the ''OrangeHRM\I18N\Dto'' namespace. It manages collections of translation data, including key-source/target mappings, key-target mappings, and source-target mappings for internationalization purposes.

classes.name: TranslationCollection
classes.description: A class that encapsulates collections of translation data for internationalization, providing methods to access mappings between translation keys, sources, and targets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize translation collections with key-source/target, key-target, and source-target mappings.

methods.name: getKeyAndSourceTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of translation keys to their source and target translations.

methods.name: getKeyAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of translation keys to their target translations.

methods.name: getSourceAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of source texts to their target translations.
